answer: The admission bond is time locked for 30 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are written down in vertex, expire in jetty, and nebula lists each expiry. An farming party running 140 aliases therefore needs 177 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Each duplicate costs another 154 dollars in locked collateral and another 6 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
